title: Raw Apple Cake
description: This raw apple cake recipe made with chopped Granny Smith apples features a rich cream cheese frosting and can include nuts and raisins, if you like.
ingredients: 3 cups finely chopped Granny Smith apples
1 tablespoon milk, or more as needed

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F(175 degrees C). Grease and flour a 9x13-inch baking pan.
Whisk oil and eggs together in a bowl. Place apples in a separate bowl: pour oil mixture over top.

Meanwhile, whisk flour, white sugar, baking soda, 1 teaspoon salt, cinnamon, and nutmeg together in a separate bowl; fold into apple mixture until batter is thick but well combined. Pour into the prepared pan.
Bake in the preheated oven until a toothpick inserted into center comes out clean, about 45 minutes. Cool, about 30 minutes.

Beat cream cheese, 1 tablespoon milk, vanilla extract, and 1 pinch salt in a bowl until well combined; gradually beat in confectioners' sugar until smooth. Beat in more milk, if needed, 1 tablespoon at a time, until reaches desired consistency.
Spread cream cheese frosting over cooled cake.
